title: Eric Eagle v. Savannah River Presbytery
disposition_detail: SJC found the complaint administratively out of order as prematurely filed because Presbytery had not completed its hearing on the complaint; no merits ruling. It reset Complainant's time to elevate the complaint to begin on the later of notification of the SJC action or Presbytery's ruling.
first_summary: A complaint against Savannah River Presbytery was premature because Presbytery had not completed its hearing. The SJC held it administratively out of order and reset the complainant's time to elevate the complaint. The decision was adopted by roll call.
summary: A complaint was filed with the SJC before Savannah River Presbytery completed its hearing on it. The SJC held the complaint administratively out of order as prematurely filed and did not reach the merits. It reset the complainant's time to elevate the complaint so that timing begins on the later of notification of the SJC action or Presbytery's ruling. The SJC adopted the decision by roll call.
